question: What immense wealth is imagined as insufficient compared to this teaching?
premises: An ocean filled with jewels is imagined
Someone might possess such an accumulation
This hyperbole sets up comparison with the teaching
inference: Even the wealth of an ocean filled with jewels is invoked as a measure of comparison.
uncertainties: ratnasaṃpūrṇamakretuṃ is a fused and unclear form in transmission
plain_english: Even if one had an accumulation enough to make the ocean filled with jewels.
